title: Nursing Shift Changeover and SBAR Handover
content:
SOP: Nursing Shift Changeover and SBAR Handover (SOP-NUR-001)
DEPARTMENT: Nursing Administration
VERSION: 3.0
ROLES: nurse
PURPOSE: Bedside verbal SBAR handover between incoming and outgoing shifts.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Nursing Shift Changeover and SBAR Handover in full compliance with Nursing Administration hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Nursing Shift Changeover and SBAR Handover in full compliance with Nursing Administration hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Nursing Shift Changeover and SBAR Handover in full compliance with Nursing Administration hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Nursing Shift Changeover and SBAR Handover in full compliance with Nursing Administration hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Nursing Shift Changeover and SBAR Handover in full compliance with Nursing Administration hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Nursing Administration.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
